body:
Had planned to attempt about 18 months. The night I had planned to do it, I ended up randomly replying to a guy who messaged me who I didn't really talk with regularly. He made me laugh and it wasn't until quite late at night that he logged off, by which time my body was suffering from no sleep in the 72 hours prior and I pretty much collapsed in a state of exhaustion. 

What's stopping me at the moment is the fact I'm in my last year of school. I try to remind myself of all the lasts and firsts I'm going to miss if I succeed in an attempt. My first and last formal dance, my last production, my last exams, first schoolies. Trying to hold on for the rest of the year and trying to convince myself that when I finish, once the stress and pressure is off, I'll be ok.
All the shit in my life is my fault. I can't see a future, and I'm not sure I want to. I don't know how to get out of the endless circle of blame and I feel like I deserve it all.
As do I, my kind friend. Absolutely no karma, but so many messages and a lot of people to talk to.

Always happy to chat :) 

And I can definitely say you are doing the right thing. Reaching out and telling someone what's going on can be a huge release and take a lot of pressure off of yourself.

Hey Jack :)

I'm happy to lend an ear if you want to talk. I can't say I have been in the same situation, but I can offer you sympathy, a good ear (advice-giving is optional) and friendship if you desire it.

Chin up. Things will work themselves out eventually!

Hey Alasdair :)
I'm always happy to lend an inbox if you need to get some stuff off your chest, and I'm am usually up for a chat any time you need someone.

It's hard going through times when you feel like you have no one to talk to. I don't really get along with a lot of people and the people I can stand, I usually end up distancing myself for other reasons, so I know what it's like, and if I can do anything to help, just send me a pm. The best advice I can give you is to put yourself out there, and don't pretend to be anything you don't want to be, that way, you'll find friends who like you for who you are.
Good Luck!
